integrity: Source iteration and predecessor HSS identities are credited; first-source date refers to Zhang–Xun 2024. Originality is a self-review and not independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-dimensional complex symmetric GADI with positive-definite diagonal real part and rank-one PSD imaginary part; exact inner solves and exact arithmetic only. Results concern Euclidean error transients and do not contradict weighted-norm convergence or establish higher-dimensional/inexact-solve behavior.
title: A sharp orientation–relaxation transient law for complex GADI iteration
